title: Piercing Frame Solo #064 (일반 허리 컷 · P25 집중형 · 하이퍼프 · 체스트넛브라운 · 메이크업 소피아로렌풍 · 금속 은 · 재질 혼합 3종(흑요암금+공작눈무늬+드래곤비늘) · 세로 띠 · 체형 크고 힘 있는 체형·매끈하게 둥근 배 · 배꼽 링)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver clicker ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four silver pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal. A silver ring passes through the rim of her navel, the navel itself a deep dimple set in the smooth swell of her belly. All jewelry is real silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a tall, powerful frame with a smooth, softly rounded belly and a full bust.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her body below the collarbones is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 49% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 72% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC SILVER scale formations, VIVID PALE BLUE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her chest, shoulders and arms, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it, down to the bottom of the frame, is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
